title: ZED Agent Readiness State
description: Per-workspace record of the three readiness stages (test-preflight, setup-service, setup). Written to .zed-agent/readiness.json by each stage as it completes. Read by run and the chain-check gate.

preflight.description: Last test-preflight invocation outcome. Considered stale by run after 24 hours.

ranAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp when Test-PreFlight returned.

verdict.description: Mirror of status — kept for human-readable consumption.

failures.description: Detail line of every check whose status was 'fail'.

warnings.description: Detail line of every check whose status was 'warn'.

overridden.description: True if the owner accepted a non-pass verdict and continued anyway.

setupService.description: Last setup-service outcome. Does not expire — setup-service is per-repo, not per-day.

lastGroup.description: Identifier of the last group successfully persisted (e.g., '11', '5b'). Useful for resuming.

missingFields.description: Dotted paths into service-config.json / pipeline-catalog.json that are still empty/placeholder.

setup.description: Last setup outcome. Does not expire — setup is per-release.

missingArtifacts.description: Files or fields that setup expected to produce but did not (e.g., 'environment.json:repoRoot', 'secrets.json:teamsChats').

inventory.description: Last Get-StampInventory.ps1 outcome for the current release. Gates Step 10 (Roll-Forward) and Step 15 (Production Rollout) when service-config.json → inventory.production.approvalRequired is true. Refreshed each time the inventory is recomputed.

status.description: 'pass' when SDS and Kusto agree within driftToleranceCount; 'drift' when reconciliation produced unmatched stamps above tolerance; 'fail' when the inventory could not be produced at all.

pipelineKey.description: Pipeline key from pipeline-catalog.json that this inventory snapshot was scoped to.

cloud.description: Cloud the snapshot was scoped to (e.g. 'Public', 'Fairfax'). Empty when the run covered all clouds.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical stamp list parsed from SDS. Used by the gate to detect SDS drift between approval and execution.

source.description: Absolute path or repo+branch+path the SDS was read from.

drift.description: Reconciliation drift entries. Empty array means SDS and Kusto agree.

approved.description: True when the owner has explicitly approved this inventory snapshot for use by Step 10 / Step 15.

approvedBy.description: Email/UPN of the owner who approved.

overridden.description: True when the owner approved despite status='drift'.
